rules.zh: 固定核心是 be + not without + possessive + noun 核心句型是：【Subject + be + not without + possessive determiner + noun phrase；The plan is not without its problems.】 這個計劃並不是完全沒有問題。 以下部分可以加入句子，但並不是固定結構的一部分：【although / even though / while；but / yet / nevertheless；according to experts；since it was introduced；despite its high cost；reporting verbs such as agree, admit and conclude；relative clauses beginning with that or which】 例如：【Although the plan is not without its problems, it may still succeed.】 雖然這個計劃並不是完全沒有問題，但仍有可能成功。 核心結構仍然只是：【the plan is not without its problems】 詞語【Although】和後面的主句都是額外的句子組織方式。
rules.en: Subject + be + not without + possessive determiner + noun phrase The plan is not without its problems. although / even though / while but / yet / nevertheless according to experts since it was introduced despite its high cost reporting verbs such as agree, admit and conclude relative clauses beginning with that or which Although the plan is not without its problems, it may still succeed. the plan is not without its problems

rules.zh: 不等於 without 這個計劃沒有風險。 這個計劃並非毫無風險。 形成含蓄的肯定意思，表示某項特點確實存在。
rules.en: Not without Without The plan is without risk. Not without The plan is not without its risks. not + without

rules.zh: 動詞要配合主語和時態一般現在時這項建議並非毫無可取之處。 這些建議並非毫無可取之處。 一般過去時這段旅程並非毫無困難。 這些討論並不是完全沒有問題。
rules.en: Be Present simple The proposal is not without its merits. The proposals are not without their merits. Past simple The journey was not without its difficulties. The discussions were not without their problems.

rules.zh: 在 not without 後面的所有格必須回指主語：單數事物用 its，複數事物用 their，人物按語境用 his 或 her，we 則配 our。例如 The plans... 必須接 their risks，不可因前一個例句使用 its 而照抄錯誤。
rules.en: the plan its The plan is not without its risks. the plans their The plans are not without their risks. the candidate his / her The candidate is not without her strengths. we our We are not without our weaknesses. the company its The company is not without its problems. Incorrect The plans are not without its risks. ✗ Correct The plans are not without their risks.

rules.zh: 情態動詞放在 be 前面這項建議可能並非毫無風險。 這項改變可能並非毫無好處。 這個解決方法將無可避免地帶來一些代價。 不要寫成：【The proposal may be not without its risks. △】 這個語序有時可以出現，但一般學習者應優先使用更自然的：【The proposal may not be without its risks.】
rules.en: Subject + modal verb + not be without + possessive + noun The proposal may not be without its risks. The change might not be without its advantages. The solution will not be without its costs. The proposal may be not without its risks. △ The proposal may not be without its risks.

rules.zh: 完成時使用 has / have not been without 這項服務一直並不是完全沒有問題。 這些討論一直並非毫無困難。 這種形式表示相關問題、優點或困難在截至目前的一段時間內曾經出現。
rules.en: Subject + has / have not been without + possessive + noun The service has not been without its problems. The discussions have not been without their difficulties.

rules.zh: 目標表達【Merits】表示「可取之處」，語氣通常有所保留這表示說話者承認這個想法有一些優點，但不一定表示完全贊成。它的語氣通常比以下句子保守：【The idea is excellent.】 這個想法非常好。 這個想法有很多優點。 因此，not without its merits 很適合用來作平衡而審慎的評價。
rules.en: Merits The idea is not without its merits. The idea is excellent. The idea has many advantages.

rules.zh: 和 drawbacks 表示保留或警告這套系統並不是完全沒有問題。 這項投資並非毫無風險。 這個方法並非毫無缺點。 這些句子承認相關方案有一定價值，但提醒讀者不要忽略其負面部分。
rules.en: Problems, risks The system is not without its problems. The investment is not without its risks. The method is not without its drawbacks.

rules.zh: 後面不使用 of 以【without】為例：本身已經是介詞，後面直接接名詞短語。
rules.en: Without Correct The plan is not without its risks. Incorrect The plan is not without of its risks. ✗

rules.zh: 表示保留式評價時，not without its 可配搭表示優點或價值的名詞，例如 merits 和 benefits；也可配搭表示缺點、風險或代價的名詞，例如 problems、risks 和 costs。
rules.en: Positive evaluation not without its merits not without its advantages not without its benefits not without its strengths not without its appeal not without its charm not without its value Negative evaluation not without its problems not without its risks not without its drawbacks not without its limitations not without its difficulties not without its complications not without its flaws not without its costs

rules.zh: 與【not without reason】等結構的分別：他感到擔心，而且不是毫無理由的。 這是相關的 not without 結構，但它沒有使用：【possessive determiner + noun referring back to the subject】 本課的核心目標是：【The plan is not without its risks.】 不是：【He was worried, not without reason.】。一般現在時或過去時：這套系統並不是完全沒有問題。 這段旅程並非毫無困難。 情態動詞：這項建議可能並非毫無風險。 完成時：這項服務一直並不是完全沒有問題。 報告句：專家同意這項建議並非毫無可取之處。 關係子句：委員會選擇了一個並非毫無風險的方案。 讓步從句：雖然這個方法並非毫無弱點，但它能產生穩定的結果。
rules.en: He was worried, and not without reason. possessive determiner + noun referring back to the subject The plan is not without its risks. He was worried, not without reason. Subject + is / are / was / were not without + possessive + noun The system is not without its problems. The journey was not without its difficulties. Subject + may / might / could / will + not be without + possessive + noun The proposal may not be without its risks. Subject + has / have not been without + possessive + noun The service has not been without its problems. Experts agree that + subject + be not without... Experts agree that the proposal is not without its merits. a plan / system / method + that / which + be not without... The committee selected an option that is not without its risks. Although / Even though / While + subject + be not without... Although the method is not without its weaknesses, it produces consistent results.

rules.zh: 與 but、yet 或 nevertheless 連用這個想法並非毫無吸引力，但需要更多證據。 加入時間、情況或觀點短語乍看之下，這個計劃並非毫無優點。 自從推出以來，這項服務一直並不是完全沒有問題。 這些開首或結尾部分只提供額外背景，並不是固定句型的一部分。
rules.en: Subject + be not without..., but / yet / nevertheless... The idea is not without its appeal, but it needs more evidence. At first sight, the plan is not without its advantages. Since it was introduced, the service has not been without its problems.

benefits.zh: 作出平衡而審慎的評價這個句型讓你承認一件事有優點或缺點，而不需要作出過於絕對的判斷。這項建議並非毫無可取之處。 這比直接說：【The proposal is excellent.】 更加審慎，也保留了進一步討論的空間。
benefits.en: The proposal is not without its merits. The proposal is excellent.

benefits.zh: 同時表達認同和保留你可以先承認一個計劃有可取之處，再指出仍然存在的問題。這項建議並非毫無可取之處，但仍需要大幅修改。 這種寫法特別適合評論、議論文、報告和會議討論。
benefits.en: The proposal is not without its merits, but it still needs substantial revision.

benefits.zh: 避免使用過於強烈的語氣第二句的批評較為含蓄，適合需要保持客觀或禮貌的情況。
benefits.en: Instead of: The system has many serious problems. You can say: The system is not without its problems.

benefits.zh: 讓論點顯得更成熟真實情況通常不是完全好或完全壞。這個句型能幫助你表達：某個方法有優點，但並不完美；某項決定有風險，但仍可能值得考慮；某個計劃有問題，但並不代表應該完全放棄。因此，它有助於建立較有層次的論點。
benefits.en: This structure creates a more mature, nuanced argument. It recognises that a method may have merits without being perfect, that a risky decision may still deserve consideration, or that a flawed plan need not be rejected completely.

benefits.zh: 這個句式可避免反覆使用 has some。與其連續寫計劃有一些優點、問題和風險，可以改用 is not without its advantages、problems 或 risks。意思仍是承認相關特點，但句式更有變化，語氣也較審慎。
benefits.en: Instead of repeatedly writing: The plan has some advantages. The plan has some problems. The plan has some risks. You can vary your language: The plan is not without its advantages. The plan is not without its problems. The plan is not without its risks.

benefits.zh: 適合正式但自然的評價這個句型常用於：作文（essays）；報告（reports）；評論（reviews）；簡報（presentations）；會議（meetings）；討論（discussions）；專業通訊它的語氣較有分寸，但不會顯得過分生硬。
